{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in the revenue column
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

print("Number of revenue entries with commas:", has_commas.sum())
print("Sample of revenue values with commas:", sales.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].sample(5).tolist())"}
